searchText: Trying to get around to doing this... The only thing I've seen are invalid blocks. Maybe a sealer on Goerli is already on London? That'd be odd though. all my goerli txs from today seem to go pending then just disappear, no matter what gas cost 😦 Thanks, Take your time. Here ya go: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/replace-the-yellow-paper-with-executable-markdown-specification/6430 There seems to have been a few hiccups on the Goerli network in the recent days. This is preventing some faucets from working properly and some people from getting enough GoETH to test their eth2/consensus client on Pyrmont or Prater. We are trying to help people join and test their build. Is there a proper channel for this? Seems like there is a lot of testing being done on the Goerli network by various entities and it's just getting harder to prevent/restrict abuse on the network and faucets. Are transactions ordered by gas price on Goerli and those with higher gas price getting included faster? maybe <@!322222239850168331> has insight here? Typically a higher gas price will get included faster. It’s unfortunately not FIFO (which it should be) There are other factors that’s a problem, and we’ve proposed some eips which should solve them but I’m not sure the status of it is there a dedicated support channel to communicate with Goerli signers? <poojaranjan19> https://gitter.im/goerli/validators (re @eth1x_bridge_bot: <Trent> is there a dedicated support channel to communicate with Goerli signers?) ah, looks like the issues may be Swarm related Thanks
